research_question: Could a SCOBY/bacterial-cellulose marine oil sorbent acidify seawater or create other local water-quality stress during deployment?
preliminary_answer: PURIFIED_NEUTRAL_RETRIEVABLE_BC_IS_NOT_EXPECTED_TO_ACIDIFY_THE_SEA_MATERIALLY; RAW_LIVE_SCOBY_OR_POORLY_WASHED_BC_IS_BLOCKED because residual acetic acid, sugars, microorganisms and dissolved organic matter could cause local pH change and oxygen demand.

scientific_basis.neutralization: Published kombucha-BC preparation protocols routinely remove culture-medium residues and microbial biomass and wash until the rinse reaches neutral pH.
scientific_basis.seawater_buffering: Seawater has substantial carbonate/bicarbonate alkalinity; typical oceanic total alkalinity is roughly 2000-2500 umol/kg. This buffers acid additions but does not justify releasing acidic material.
scientific_basis.biodegradation: Cellulose can biodegrade in seawater over weeks to months; microbial mineralization consumes oxygen and produces CO2. Therefore loose fragments or intentionally abandoned material could create local oxygen/pH stress even if the polymer itself is not acidic.
scientific_basis.regulatory_context: EPA recognizes cellulose fibers as a natural organic sorbent class, but field use remains subject to response oversight and product composition.

internal_promotion_gates_not_regulatory.A1_pH: Absolute sample-minus-blank pH shift after 24 h <= 0.10 pH unit under the frozen test conditions.
internal_promotion_gates_not_regulatory.A2_DO: Dissolved-oxygen loss attributable to the sorbent <=10% relative to matched blank over 24 h.
internal_promotion_gates_not_regulatory.A3_rinse: Final production rinse is near-neutral and stable before drying/conditioning.
internal_promotion_gates_not_regulatory.A4_organics: No large unexplained increase in TOC/COD or acetate relative to blank; report analytical detection limits and absolute values.
internal_promotion_gates_not_regulatory.A5_fragments: No visible fragment escape from the contained pad/cartridge and >=99% dry-equivalent sorbent retrieval.
internal_promotion_gates_not_regulatory.A6_treatment: Any hydrophobic treatment must pass the same leachate test independently; untreated BC passing does not automatically clear a coating.
internal_promotion_gates_not_regulatory.A7_repeat: Pass reproduced in at least two independent BC batches.

janus_tranception.forward: FERMENTED_SCOBY -> PURIFY/WASH -> NEUTRAL_RINSE -> DRY/ENGINEER -> MARINE_CONTACT -> RETRIEVE -> NO_MATERIAL_PH_SHIFT_OR_OXYGEN_STRESS

main_risks: residual acetic acid and fermentation broth
biodegradation-driven oxygen demand if material is lost
design_verdict.collaboration_position_for_green_boom: Present the concept as a recoverable purified bacterial-cellulose insert with a preregistered pH/leachate/DO gate, not as raw kombucha SCOBY.
